title: You ship a new version and users never notice. Here's how
caption: Rolling updates in plain English. Have you ever had to roll back in production?

scenes.vo: You push a new version of your app. Your users never notice. That's a rolling update.
scenes.heading: ROLLING UPDATES
scenes.group_label: old and new, side by side

scenes.vo: Kubernetes swaps Pods a few at a time. Old v1 Pods are replaced by new v2 Pods, only once the new ones are ready.
scenes.heading: A FEW AT A TIME

scenes.vo: Traffic only goes to Pods that pass their readiness check. So users always hit a working version.
scenes.heading: WHO GETS TRAFFIC?

scenes.vo: Something broke? Don't panic. One command takes you straight back to the previous version.
scenes.heading: THE TRICK?

scenes.vo: Rolling updates: zero downtime, health checked, and one command to undo. Follow for more Kubernetes in plain English.
scenes.heading: ROLLING UPDATES
